tagline: 理光便携相机，1994 年发布
description: 理光于1994年推出的便携相机。配备38mm f/4.5 - 105mm f/8.9 2.8X Zoom, 7 elements in 6 groups。快门速度Programmed, 1 sec.(super-night mode) 1/2 - 1/400 sec.(normal mode)。感光度ISO 50 - 3200 (DX-code system)。7-point passive autofocus system, 1027 focusing steps, Spot-AF facility。

specs.镜头: 38mm f/4.5 - 105mm f/8.9 2.8X Zoom, 7 elements in 6 groups
specs.对焦: 7-point passive autofocus system, 1027 focusing steps, Spot-AF facility
specs.闪光灯: G.N.20 m (iso 100), Auto / On / Off, Red-eye reduction, Daylight-synchro, Slow-synchro
specs.英文简介: The Myport Super Zoom is an autofocus compact camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1994.
